project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite 7 + Supabase SPA (frontend only in repo), deployed on Vercel
build_system: npm (Node v22.23.3, npm 11.4.2). Build is 'tsc -b && vite build'.
test_framework: Vitest 3.2.4 with jsdom env, globals:true, setupFiles ./src/test/setup.ts. Tests live in src/**/__tests__/*.test.ts
verification_instructions: After npm install: npm run build must pass clean (tsc -b project refs then vite build producing dist/). Also run npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint (eslint .), npm run test (vitest run). Capture pass/fail of each.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/types/database.ts is generated by the user via `supabase gen types` - MUST NOT be hand-edited. package-lock.json is generated by `npm install` and MUST be committed.
setup_instructions: npm install (regenerates package-lock.json). .env.local not required for build (only VITE_ vars at runtime).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET confirmed; registry.npmjs.org returns HTTP 200. npm install is allowed.
contribution_requirements: HARD CONSTRAINTS: do NOT hand-edit src/types/database.ts; do NOT alter supabase/migrations/. Work only on branch fix/deps-build-compat; commit locally, do NOT push.
key_patterns: Vite '@' -> ./src alias. ESLint flat config in eslint.config.js. Prettier config .prettierrc.json. tsconfig split: tsconfig.json (refs), tsconfig.app.json, tsconfig.node.json.
relevant_files: vercel.json (to be created at repo root)
directory_structure: Repo root at /projects/sandbox/kiro-athen. src/ holds React app (components, domain, features, routes, types). supabase/migrations/ holds SQL. public/ holds assets. Config files at root.
